title: A cookie that omits Domain belongs only to the host that set it
summary: The host-only cookie only matches the original host; the legal Domain attribute allows it to match the domain and subdomains.
applies: Browser interpretation of URLs, cookies, and origins
detail: For example, a cookie set by app.example.test with Domain omitted is not sent with a request to api.example.test.
boundary: The sending of cookies is also affected by conditions such as Path, Secure, SameSite, etc.; the same host cannot guarantee sending based on this.
relevance: Explain from the static request log why the browser saved the cookie but not sent it on another subdomain.
